title: Sunflower Place | KEY.co
description_expanded: The charm extends to the second floor, where a cozy sitting area with a TV provides a quiet retreat. Additional sleeping quarters include three king-size bedrooms and a guest room with two queen beds, each with private bathrooms, alongside a bunk space ideal for younger guests. The screened-in porch, overlooking a lush green space, offers an idyllic setting for outdoor dining or enjoying the big game in comfort. Completing this idyllic retreat, the carriage house features its own cozy living space, kitchenette, and king-size bed. Guests can also take advantage of the included six-seat golf cart and five beach cruiser bicycles to explore the stunning Watercolor community, known for its picturesque scenery and top-tier amenities. Whether seeking relaxation or adventure, this home promises a luxurious stay, enveloped by nature's beauty and designed with every comfort in mind. Set in the tranquil Crossings District of Watercolor, this vacation home is a quintessential blend of elegance and coastal charm. With a striking view of the nature preserve, the property boasts a spacious layout including a main house and a separate carriage house, ensuring ample room for up to 14 guests. The beautifully manicured front yard and inviting porch lead into a serene interior adorned with an open floor plan that combines a cozy living room, a stylish dining area that seats twelve, and a gourmet chef's kitchen. Stainless steel appliances, a beverage fridge, and bar stool seating enhance the culinary space, making it perfect for family gatherings or entertaining friends. The first floor is completed by a luxurious master suite featuring a king-size bed and an opulent bathroom with a walk-in shower and soaking tub.
